authority: diagnostic: paper only, not investment advice
flags: Versant separated from Comcast and became a standalone publicly traded company, with its Class A stock starting to trade on Nasdaq under the ticker VSNT.
In connection with the Separation, Versant incurred about $3.0 billion of debt (Senior Notes and Term Loans) and used part of the proceeds to fund a cash payment to Comcast of $2.25 billion.
Versant acquired Full Swing, a sports technology company, for approximately $536 million in cash.

business_model.claim: Versant is a media and entertainment company that serves four core markets (political news, business news and personal finance, golf and athletics participation, and sports and genre entertainment) through TV networks and digital platforms. It reports one segment, so the filings give no profit split by business line.
quotes: Versant is a media and entertainment business that operates in four core markets: political news and opinion, business news and personal finance, golf and athletics participation and sports and genre entertainment.
We present our operations in one reportable business segment.

business_model.claim: Customers are the viewing audience, paying subscribers, advertisers, distributors and licensing counterparties. Money comes from four streams: distributing networks, selling advertising, digital platform services and content licensing.
quotes: We generate revenue primarily through distributing our networks, selling advertising across our brands, providing services through our digital platforms and content licensing.
delivering value to key constituents: the viewing audience, paying subscribers, advertisers, distributors and licensing counterparties

business_model.basis: stated in the cited items (MD&A revenue table; the income statement shows the same total)
business_model.claim: In the latest nine months, revenue was 4,925 in total (table in millions). Linear distribution was 2,894, advertising 1,164, platforms 662 and content licensing and other 205, so linear distribution is the largest stream.

Linear distribution revenue is a per-subscriber fee times the number of subscribers a distributor carries. It is falling as subscribers decline, with contractual rate increases only partly offsetting. The third-quarter figure was 935 against 992 a year earlier (table in millions).
quotes: Our revenue from distribution agreements is generally based on the number of subscribers receiving our television networks through the provider and a per subscriber fee.

Linear distribution revenue decreased for the three and nine months ended September 30, 2026 as compared to the corresponding prior year periods, primarily due to continued declines in subscribers, which were partially offset by contractual rate increases.

business_model.claim: Advertising is sold on the networks and digital properties, and its pricing and volume depend on audience ratings. Ratings declines of 17% pushed 2025 advertising revenue down. In the third quarter it was 373 against 394 a year earlier (table in millions). NBCUniversal sells domestic linear and related digital ad inventory on Versant's behalf for about two years.
quotes: Effective with the Separation and pursuant to a commercial agreement between NBCUniversal and us, NBCUniversal will sell domestic linear and related digital advertising inventory on our behalf for approximately two years.

business_model.claim: Platforms revenue (GolfNow, Fandango and others) is generally transaction-based and has been growing. The third-quarter figure was 245 against 224 a year earlier (table in millions). The Full Swing acquisition added 23 (in millions), and the SportsEngine sale reduced platforms revenue.
quotes: Our revenue related to these platforms is generally transaction-based, and depending on the service, generally consists of an agreed share based on the value of underlying transactions, transaction-based fees paid by the consumer or fixed amounts for individual transactions or services provided.

business_model.claim: Content licensing and other revenue is lumpy and depends on the timing of licensing deals. Nine-month revenue was 205 against 154 a year earlier (table in millions), helped by a large licensing agreement in the first quarter of 2026.
quotes: The year-to-date period includes the impact of a large licensing agreement recognized during the first quarter of 2026.

business_model.basis: stated in the cited items; the 'fixed by contract' reading is inferred from multiyear terms
business_model.claim: The largest cost is programming and production, which includes amortization of content and sports rights. It was 1,777 of 2,167 total cost of revenue in the latest nine months (table in millions). Sports rights are mostly multiyear contracts with leagues, so much of the cost base is fixed by contract.
quotes: Programming and production costs primarily consist of the amortization of licensed and owned content, including sports rights, direct production costs, production overhead and on-air talent costs.
Our sports programming and related content is typically licensed under multiyear contractual agreements with the relevant sports leagues.

business_model.claim: Other costs of revenue are mainly direct platform costs and rise with digital transaction volume. They were 389 against 363 in the latest nine months (table in millions).
quotes: primarily due to higher transactional volumes related to our digital platforms and costs related to Full Swing

business_model.claim: As a standalone company Versant carries debt and public-company costs that the prior combined statements did not. It took on about $3.0 billion of debt at the Separation and paid Comcast a special cash payment. Interest expense was 53 in the third quarter and 157 over nine months (in millions), with none in the prior-year periods. Long-term debt on the latest balance sheet was 2,813 (table in millions).
quotes: we incurred approximately $3.0 billion of total debt

business_model.claim: Results have weakened in the latest quarter: revenue fell, and operating income and Adjusted EBITDA fell faster, as linear and ad declines meet higher costs.

Distribution renewals are a key revenue risk: the company says the Separation may weaken its negotiating position with MVPDs because it can no longer bundle programming with NBCU's broadcast networks, Bravo and Peacock.
quotes: As a result of the Separation, our negotiating position with MVPDs may be weakened without the ability to sell our programming along with NBCU’s broadcast television networks, the Bravo cable network and Peacock.

competitive_position.basis: stated in the cited items (company statements)
competitive_position.claim: Versant reports large audience reach across its networks: over 50 million weekly viewers in the prior fiscal year and more than 120 million monthly viewers in the third quarter of 2026, with aggregate viewership up double digits year over year.
quotes: with over 50 million viewers having watched content on a Versant network each week in 2025
In the third quarter of 2026, Versant’s networks reached more than 120 million viewers monthly, while aggregate viewership grew double digits year over year.

competitive_position.basis: stated in the cited items (revenue table); the dependence on the pay-TV bundle is inferred from the revenue description
competitive_position.claim: Versant sells news, sports and entertainment brands through four revenue streams, and linear distribution is the largest: $4,092 (table in millions) of $6,688 (table in millions) total revenue in the latest annual period.
quotes: We generate revenue primarily through distributing our networks, selling advertising across our brands, providing services through our digital platforms and content licensing.

competitive_position.claim: Linear distribution is shrinking. Subscribers fell 8% in each of the last two annual periods, and third-quarter 2026 linear revenue was $935 (table in millions) against $992 a year earlier, a change of (5.8)%.
quotes: Linear distribution revenue decreased in 2025 and 2024, primarily due to declines in the number of subscribers of 8% in each of these periods, respectively, partially offset by contractual rate increases.

Linear distribution revenue decreased for the three and nine months ended September 30, 2026 as compared to the corresponding prior year periods, primarily due to continued declines in subscribers, which were partially offset by contractual rate increases.

competitive_position.claim: Advertising revenue is under pressure from ratings declines of 17%. Third-quarter 2026 advertising was $373 (table in millions) against $394, a change of (5.3)%, although management says recent trends have improved.
quotes: Advertising revenue decreased in 2025 and 2024, as compared to the corresponding prior year periods, primarily due to decreases at our networks as a result of ratings declines of 17% and 8%, respectively.
These results reflect improvements in recent trends including favorable ratings at our networks.

competitive_position.claim: The digital Platforms business is the growth area: third-quarter 2026 revenue was $245 (table in millions) against $224, up 9.6%, helped by Fandango and $23 million from Full Swing.
quotes: Platforms revenue increased for the three and nine months ended September 30, 2026 as compared to the corresponding prior year periods, primarily due to increased revenue at Fandango, as well as $23 million of revenue related to Full Swing, which was acquired in August 2026.

competitive_position.basis: stated in the cited item; the complementarity is the company's stated rationale
competitive_position.claim: Versant is extending its golf and sports-technology position through acquisition: Full Swing was bought for approximately $536 million in cash.
quotes: On August 3, 2026, we acquired Full Swing, a leading sports technology company with patented hardware and integrated software used by consumers, competitive athletes, coaches, and commercial venues, for approximately $536 million in cash, subject to customary purchase price adjustments.

competitive_position.claim: Versant holds long-term sports rights that give programming visibility. The earliest expiry in the rights table is the Premier League in the 2027-28 season.
quotes: Premier League | 2027-28 season

We have exclusive, long-term rights to currently airing major sports content and properties with terms that extend into the 2030s, providing long-term business visibility and we intend to evaluate opportunities to supplement our sports rights portfolio.

competitive_position.claim: The company names rising sports-rights costs and competition for programming as a threat. It says renewal of existing sports agreements at attractive rates is not assured.
quotes: As a result, there can be no assurance that we will be able to renew our existing sports programming agreements at attractive rates, or at all.

competitive_position.basis: risk stated in the 10-K; the renewal statement is a company claim in the earnings release

quotes: As a result of the Separation, our negotiating position with MVPDs may be weakened without the ability to sell our programming along with NBCU’s broadcast television networks, the Bravo cable network and Peacock.
audience growth and the completion of all planned pay television distribution renewals for the year

competitive_position.basis: stated in the cited item; the dependence is inferred

quotes: Effective with the Separation and pursuant to a commercial agreement between NBCUniversal and us, NBCUniversal will sell domestic linear and related digital advertising inventory on our behalf for approximately two years.

competitive_position.basis: stated figures; the reading of the standalone measure as a prior-year adjustment is inferred from the reconciliation rows

quotes: Standalone Adjusted EBITDA | $381 | $1,658

competitive_position.claim: Revenue is declining and the full-year outlook sits below the latest annual revenue. Third-quarter 2026 revenue was $1,594 (table in millions) against $1,663, a change of (4.2)%, and management reaffirmed a full-year range of $6.2 billion to $6.45 billion.
quotes: Total Revenue: Reaffirmed outlook of $6.2 billion to $6.45 billion

competitive_position.basis: balance sheet and income statement figures are stated; the interest burden effect is inferred
competitive_position.claim: Versant carries meaningful debt taken on at the Separation. Long-term debt was $2,813 (table in millions) plus a current portion of $113, against cash of $1,051, and third-quarter interest expense was $53. Management describes the company as well-capitalized.
quotes: We are a well-capitalized business with multiple revenue streams and significant operating cash flows.
In connection with our Separation we issued $3.0 billion of total debt, including the Senior Notes issued in October 2025 and borrowings under the Term Loans drawn upon the Separation.

competitive_position.basis: stated in the risk factors and MD&A
competitive_position.claim: Structural change in video viewing is the central threat the company names. Cord-cutting, streaming, social platforms and generative AI-enabled competitors may cut distribution revenue, ratings and advertiser demand.
quotes: Technological advances and evolving consumer preferences have changed how audiences consume video content, reducing the number of subscribers to MVPDs and, in turn, adversely affecting businesses like ours that derive distribution revenue from MVPDs.
Competitors with significant resources, greater efficiencies of scale and fewer regulatory burdens continue to increasingly compete with our businesses.

financial_health.basis: Stated in the MD&A and the cash flow statement.

financial_health.basis: Stated in the 10-K MD&A; its size is not given in the evidence.

financial_health.basis: Balances are stated; the coverage reading is inferred from them.

quotes: Platforms revenue increased for the three and nine months ended September 30, 2026 as compared to the corresponding prior year periods, primarily due to increased revenue at Fandango, as well as $23 million of revenue related to Full Swing, which was acquired in August 2026.
